content:
It's time to check out our carefully curated selection of the latest iPhone 18 Pro case recommendations. Apple has released brand new silicone cases and TechWoven fabric cases, with colors designed to perfectly complement the phone, plus our long-trusted third-party brand favorites. From the new wine red model with a built-in stand, to highly grippy customizable models, to premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods—we've got everything you're looking for. There are also great value options from high cost-performance brands like Spigen, starting at just $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Updated 9/27: Added several exclusive promo codes for 9to5 readers.

Apple

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case (MagSafe compatible) — Mulberry Purple: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case (MagSafe compatible) — Light Blue: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case (MagSafe compatible) — Wine Red: $49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case (MagSafe compatible) — Navy Blue: $49

Featured Partner: ESR

ESR's new iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories collection is now on sale, bringing top-tier color craftsmanship, patented technology, and more highlights. The star of this new product lineup is the latest Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic case, equipped with a zinc alloy Flex stand built into the camera protection area, providing 3x military-grade protection and a "soft and comfortable grip." Like other accessory collections, the new Atelier also comes in four color options, perfectly matching the iPhone 18 Pro in wine red, glacier, black, and silver.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case (with Flex Stand) $42 (original price $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet with Stand (Non-Slip Edition) $46 (original price $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

When it comes to leather cases, Nomad is one of the industry's top brands, and their flagship models now fully support the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year they also introduced a brand new Rugged Case series, with each color engraved with topographic contour patterns inspired by Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Partner: Dbrand

Dbrand is set to launch their classic Grip case, supporting the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to the clean look and ultra-grippy feel, it once again supports a wide variety of customizable skins, and you can get an additional discount when adding a compatible Prism screen protector.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $55 Customizable, drop protection, ultra-grippy, crisp button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) 2-pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Easy installation, auto-alignment, zero dust particles

This year Dbrand also launched a brand new MNML brand phone case, starting at just $39, featuring minimalist aesthetics, better value, MagSafe compatibility, and the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Military Blue, Tan Brown, Wine Red

****Note: SANDMARC products traditionally only go on sale once a year...unless you use the exclusive promo code above.

Bluebonnet

Bluebonnet is a small Texas-based shop specializing in handcrafted premium full-grain leather phone cases, featuring a one-piece fully wrapped design—completely plastic-free—with copper-plated metal buttons. We've also secured an exclusive 20% off deal for 9to5 readers on this new iPhone 18 Pro case:

  • Full-Grain Leather Minimalist iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Case $63 (original price $79) Enter promo code 9to5 at checkout

Luriax

  • The Signature Suede-like (iPhone 18 Pro) $107 (original price $120) Enter promo code 9TO5 at checkout
  • The Modern Suede-like (iPhone 18 Pro) $62 (original price $69)

Arc

The 2026 Arc Pulse aviation-grade metal bumper phone case officially debuts, with new color choices this year to match Apple's glacier and wine red phones:

  • Matte Black – $69.99

  • Polished Graphite – $99.99
  • Matte Light Blue – $119.99
  • Matte Deep Red – $119.99

  • iPhone 18 Series All-Leather Phone Case $59

  • iPhone 18 Series Modular Phone Case $59
  • Detachable magnetic backplate, switch between two modes. With backplate installed: full-grain leather phone case, slim and MagSafe compatible

Burton Goods

***Note: Enter our exclusive promo code 9TO520 at checkout to get an additional 20% off the already discounted launch price of the following phone cases. If it doesn't work, try entering DUO10.

  • Luxury Pocket Book Wallet Phone Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $89 (original price $119)

  • Alto Laser-Engraved Wood Grain iPhone 18 Pro Phone Case starting at $33 (10% off) Enter promo code 9TO5MAC at checkout Engraved Collection Vintage Inlay Collection Supports custom image uploads

UAG

UAG has also launched a series of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including their signature rugged models with reinforced corner protection, non-slip edges, and various drop-protection-focused designs. If you're looking for a phone case designed for heavy use and daily protection, UAG's lineup is definitely worth considering.

  • UAG Mouve $65 (for iPhone Duo)
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 (for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max)
  • UAG Civilian Non-Slip Case starting at $60
  • And more...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Phone Case

If you want to pair a rugged case with your new phone but don't want to go with common brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is worth checking out. These cases have passed MIL-STD-810H drop testing, provide reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotatable stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a less bulky but more premium case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. They now offer ultra-thin aramid fiber cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, with other recommended models listed below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fiber Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fiber Case $70
  • And more...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro phone cases tend to lean toward more forward-thinking designs, with futuristic shapes, slim profiles, and unique textures that stand out from common phone cases.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case $60 (for iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are perfect for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users seeking a slim profile. Their cases typically use lightweight aramid fiber, with a clean minimalist look, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and adding reinforced protection at the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fiber Texture Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Aramid Drop Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox has prepared a lineup of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, ranging from slim daily models to rugged heavy-duty designs, catering to different protection needs. Many new models support MagSafe, and some add features like non-slip sides, accessory storage, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, allowing you to choose based on your preferences for thickness and protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Pro Series $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more...

Belkin

If you're looking for a cleaner, lighter case for your iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max than fully rugged models, Belkin is a reliable brand. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear cases and protective cases with raised edges around the screen and camera. Some models (like Protect+) feature reinforced corners, striking a good balance between daily protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2 Compatible MagSafe Non-Slip Case $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners $60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is another brand that typically gets ahead with new phone cases—their iPhone 18 Pro series is already on sale with a rich selection. This brand is known for colorful designs, bold patterns, and protection features that don't look too tool-like. Most models in the series support MagSafe, with clear, impact-resistant, and more fashionable options.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case $56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case $64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Case (MagSafe compatible) $64
  • And more...

Speck

Speck's iPhone 18 Pro series continues the brand's everyday protection style with clean designs. The series includes several slim non-slip cases, as well as MagSafe-compatible models and clear designs that show off the phone's original color. These cases also offer decent drop protection without making the phone too bulky.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case $50 (for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max)
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case (MagSafe compatible) $50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case (MagSafe compatible) $40
  • And more...

elago

elago phone cases tend toward clean minimalist designs, and the prices are also more affordable than other options. The lineup typically includes slim silicone in simple colors, clear, and MagSafe-compatible models, perfectly complementing Apple's device colors.

  • elago Urban Clear Case $14 (original price $16)
  • elago Pebble Case $15 (original price $17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case $19 (original price $25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case $19
  • And more...
